Horde Character Lineup
Horde charactersDark medieval · blocky style

The horde is your three fodder zombies, a third of each, hundreds of them, each with its own size and skin tone. The horde attacks from the front. Player 1, the paladin with his shield up, is in front of the camera; player 2, the hunter, shoots from the left and steps between two spots so you can see the dog keep within its range (the green ring). The wizard walks between spots on the right and slashes with his sword, so you can see how your model moves.
